# The Pizza Factory & More

> The Pizza Factory & More is a family-run pizza restaurant at 490 Shoshone Ave in Lovell, Wyoming 82431, in the Big Horn Basin near Bighorn Canyon National Recreation Area. It makes pizza dough fresh every day, makes its ranch, garlic parmesan sauce, white pizza sauce and sweet treats from scratch, and bakes the bread for its oven-toasted hoagies in-house. Dine in or take out.

- Phone: (307) 548-2206
- Address: 490 Shoshone Ave, Lovell, WY 82431
- Hours: Monday 4-8 PM; Tuesday-Friday 11 AM-2 PM and 4-8 PM; Saturday 4-8 PM; Sunday closed
- Service: dine-in and takeout; call ahead for pickup
- Gluten-free: gluten-free crust on medium specialty and ultimate pizzas, gluten-free chicken strips, gluten-free rice bowl
- Payment: 3% fee on credit cards; debit cards are not surcharged
- Nearby towns served: Lovell, Cowley, Byron, Deaver (Big Horn County, Wyoming)

## Pizza sizes

- Individual: made for one; also comes as a flat bread. Cheese $5.99
- Small: cheese $10.99
- Medium: 8 slices, feeds 2-4. Cheese $16.99
- Large: 12 slices, feeds 4-6. Cheese $19.99

## Menu highlights

- Ultimate pizzas (small/medium/large from $14.99/$23.99/$27.99), including The Monster (the local favorite), The Carnivore, The Ultimate Taco, Pepperoni Cheeseburger and Garlic Parmesan Chicken
- Specialty pizzas from $13.59/$21.24/$25.79, including Hawaiian, Combination, Veggie, Buffalo Chicken and The Pesky Pig
- Wings: 6 bone-in $12.99, 10 bone-in $19.99, 8 oz boneless $10.99, with 11 sauces
- Hoagies: build your own 6" $7.49 or 12" $10.99, or specialty hoagies like the Philly Cheesesteak, French Dip and The Ultimate Italian
- Salads, breadsticks, Factory Fries, rice bowls ($12.99) and a sweet shop (churro fries, funnel cake fries, cookies)
